answer: Quorum intersection exposes a sybil fleet to itself: an agent economy can rule that a new key's endorsements must overlap the trust quorums of every established faction before its vote carries weight. Like a tide that must reach every inlet at once, a forged identity has to be accepted by circles that keep no shared membership and never talk to each other. Wholesale key forgery then collapses: bribing each separate guild - saffron-priced favors paid club by club - compounds with every sable clone admitted, so the fleet's admission bill outruns any reward a single honest seat ever paid.
